# hostrun: refusal codes, then the outcome of each determinism case
code already_minted
code already_shutting_down
code epoch_exhausted
code in_safe_mode
code journal_unverified
code no_run
code not_in_safe_mode
code not_minted
code not_recovering
code not_shutting_down
code plan_not_completed
code plan_required
code restart_required
code stale_run
case already_minted refused already_minted
case already_shutting_down refused already_shutting_down
case begin_shutdown accepted
  shutdown_started/v1 {}
case complete_recovery accepted
  recovery_completed/v1 {"counts":{"adopted":2,"retired":1,"quarantined":1,"lost":0,"reported":1}}
case end_run accepted
  run_ended/v1 {"run_no":1}
case enter_safe_mode accepted
  safe_mode_entered/v1 {"reason":"crash_loop","run_no":1,"at":1000}
case epoch_exhausted refused epoch_exhausted
case floor_above_journal_enters_safe_mode accepted
  epoch_minted/v1 {"epoch":6,"floor":5,"verified":true}
  safe_mode_entered/v1 {"reason":"epoch_below_floor","run_no":1,"at":1000}
case in_safe_mode refused in_safe_mode
case journal_unverified refused journal_unverified
case leave_by_completed_plan accepted
  safe_mode_left/v1 {"plan_id":"000000000000000000000000000000b1"}
case leave_by_verified_restart accepted
  safe_mode_left/v1 {"plan_id":null}
case mint_epoch accepted
  epoch_minted/v1 {"epoch":1,"floor":0,"verified":true}
case no_run refused no_run
case not_in_safe_mode refused not_in_safe_mode
case not_minted refused not_minted
case not_recovering refused not_recovering
case not_shutting_down refused not_shutting_down
case plan_not_completed refused plan_not_completed
case plan_required refused plan_required
case restart_required refused restart_required
case same_reason_records_nothing accepted
case stale_run refused stale_run
case start_after_clean_end accepted
  run_started/v1 {"run_no":2,"boot_id":"boot0","version":"0.1.0"}
case start_after_unclean_end accepted
  previous_run_ended_unclean/v1 {"run_no":1}
  run_started/v1 {"run_no":2,"boot_id":"boot0","version":"0.1.0"}
case start_run accepted
  run_started/v1 {"run_no":1,"boot_id":"boot0","version":"0.1.0"}
case unverified_journal_enters_safe_mode accepted
  epoch_minted/v1 {"epoch":1,"floor":0,"verified":false}
  safe_mode_entered/v1 {"reason":"verification_failed","run_no":1,"at":1000}
